name: unilog-demo-build
description: Hackathon demo film for unilog - evidence-first catalog enrichment

scripts.dev: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts --no-open
scripts.compositions: npm run assets && remotion compositions src/index.ts
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run compositions
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts Demo demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p && npm run finalize
scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -v error -i demo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -c:a copy -movflags +faststart demo_fixed.mp4 && mv demo_fixed.mp4 demo.mp4
scripts.poster: npm run assets && remotion still src/index.ts Demo poster.png --frame=300
